workstream: long_loci, frozen run on the lut test set
status_when_written: Read from the dataset before writing: README.txt, MANIFEST.json / MANIFEST.tsv (file list, row counts, sha256), directory listings, and the code text of package code/tokens.sbatch and code/mmseqs_tokens.py (no data). No parquet, npy, FASTA or JSON content of the package has been opened; no ELSA method, similarity pass, neighbour list or token build has been run on it. Every DPANN and Spacedust number of parts 1-5 is known (development results).

dataset.as_described: 1,032 GTDB r232 species representatives, 4,507,042 proteins (4,464,102 unique), DPANN layout; ESM++ small embeddings with the zca10 whitening stored (fitted label-free by slice_lut's embed/zca10.py); gold lut_instances (lut_homology_main 733, lut_homology_strict 121), ribosomal runs g2_m16 858 in 855 genomes; layers a1 80 / a2 96 / a3 141 / a4 341 / b1 166 / b2 134 / c1 56 / c2 18; split odd 516 / even 516.

rule_for_every_data_derived_number: Nothing is chosen on this dataset. Every number computed from data is produced by the rule fixed on DPANN (and applied unchanged on Spacedust): bond tau by the bond-level 1% shuffle rule, list tau by vl's instance-FDR rule, genome groups by the emb_hom 0.75 average-linkage rule, cohesion floors from 1,000,000 random cross-genome gene pairs (seed 17), exclusion masks by softrec mode 1. Whitening is the package's stored transform (fitted by slice_lut without labels); it is applied, never refitted. Outputs at other theta values and other tree variants are written by the unchanged code but are never scored, read or reported.

PRIMARY.name: family-bond tree, adaptive distance (part 4 selected output: dpann_WA L4b_t0.2)
PRIMARY.tokens: rescue3 family tokens built here with the DPANN recipe: base mmseqs cluster -s 7.5 -e 1e-3 --min-seq-id 0 -c 0.5 --cov-mode 0 --cluster-mode 0 (MMseqs2 release 18) -> mmseqs_tokens.py; rescue3: unique sequences, genes in base tokens of < 3 genes searched against all unique sequences (prefilter -s 7.5 --max-seqs 1000; align -e 1e-5 -a) -> 06b_rescue3.py (package code copies, sha256 in MANIFEST)
PRIMARY.counting_unit: genome groups: emb_hom(A,B) = mean over A's genes (gene multiplicity) of the best zca10 cosine in B, over genes with that cosine >= 0.5 (0.32 when none); mean-symmetrised; average linkage on 1 - emb_hom; cut at 0.75 (fcluster distance 0.25). Sums from the exact GPU table (transfer_spacedust gtable.py, copied with paths changed); groups by transfer_spacedust emb.py groups (lineagefree genome_groups.py definition, copied)
PRIMARY.bonds: lw.py WA: every token pair at distance d (1..8 positions on one contig) tested at window d: n_d = groups with an occurrence at distance <= d, E_d = learner expected_groups with w = d, Lambda_d = n ln(n/E) - n + E; bond if n_d >= 2 and Lambda_d >= tau; tokens in < 2 groups are not symbols (min_n 2); s_k = largest Lambda of a bond spanning boundary k
PRIMARY.tau: smallest value of (4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50) with bond FDR = mean significant occurrences over 3 within-genome token shuffles (rng 1000 + r, contig sizes kept) / observed <= 0.01 (DPANN gave 6, Spacedust 8)
PRIMARY.cohesion: token cohesion kappa_var_tokens (context_units cuts.py side_sums / gene_cohesion as copied in transfer_spacedust emb.py cohesion): per boundary min of right / left side cohesion of the token's neighbour-vector set, floor c0 = mean cosine of 1,000,000 random cross-genome gene pairs (seed 17), zca10 float32 vectors
PRIMARY.tree: part-1 L4b: tie-collapsed min-rooted tree over L1 runs with w_k = s_k, and low-cohesion junctions (kappa < theta, theta = 0.2) as the first splits (w_k = 1e-6 + max(kappa, 0))
PRIMARY.node_filter: closed-form family node test at the bond tau: n = groups other than the node's own holding >= max(2, ceil(0.5 |families|)) of the node's distinct non-singleton families within <= 2|I| genes; E closed form; kept if n >= 2, Lambda(n, E) >= tau and nI >= 2

SECONDARY.name: embedding-list tree, fixed distance (part 2 selected Z output: L4bp_t0.02)
SECONDARY.lists: z >= 10.6 lists: per gene, one best match per other genome (max zca10 cosine; z = (max - mean) / sd over that genome's genes), genomes of the gene's own group excluded; z table from the exact GPU pass (same pass as the group sums), stored at z >= 10.5
SECONDARY.bonds: vl.py round 0 through lb.Lrn (kernels imported read-only from vocab_lists vl.py): adjacencies within <= 2 intervening genes (WGAP 3), 'grp' counting (n = 1 + supporting groups, E over groups, n >= 2, Lambda >= tau), round-0 homolog exclusion masks K1000 (softrec exclusion mode 1; capcos at depth 1,000 from softrec expand_knn on the exact k = 2,000 cosine kNN outside the lineage unit)
SECONDARY.tau: vl's rule computed here: smallest value of vl.LADDER (4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20) with round-0 instance FDR over 3 gene-order shuffles <= vl.FDR (0.01) (DPANN 6, Spacedust 8)
SECONDARY.cohesion: family-free kNN cohesion kappa_var_knn50 (context_units cuts.py gene_cohesion_knn as copied in sdu.py: kh 50, cap_h 200, floor from 1,000,000 random cross-genome gene pairs, seed 17)
SECONDARY.tree: L4b tree at theta 0.02 with the kNN cohesion; every node with >= 2 genes kept (L4b+, no node test)

inputs_built_here.uid_map: gid -> uid from embeddings/esmpp_small__uid_of_row.npy after a gate: rows are gids (row count = genes) and genes sharing a uid have identical sequences in proteins_gid.faa (sha1 of every sequence)
inputs_built_here.zca10_float32: the stored transform (zca10_transform.npz) applied to esmpp_small__mean_raw_f32__uid.npy exactly as slice_lut embed/zca10.py applies it; gate: equal to the stored zca10_f16__uid.npy within float16 rounding (max abs difference <= 1e-3). If the transform cannot be applied exactly, the float16 vectors are upcast (recorded as a deviation)
inputs_built_here.gtable: transfer_spacedust gtable.py copied (paths only): z table (Z_STORE 10.5) + genome-pair sums, one A5000 (partition gpu), fp16 vectors
inputs_built_here.knn: gpu_knn_sd.py copied (paths only): exact cosine kNN, k 2,000, one A5000
inputs_built_here.prep: sdu.py cmd_prep copied into a lut adapter (paths only): kappa_var_knn50, exclusion masks for lineage = group (and genome, as written by the copied code) for the observed order and shuffles 0-2
inputs_built_here.adapter_rule: lut adapters (ll.DATA entry, sdu copy) change paths only; diffs are recorded in the notebook with sha256 of each adapter

comparators.pair_linking: L1 of each configuration's own bonds (WA family bonds at the WA tau; Z list bonds at the Z tau): runs of bonded boundaries
comparators.engine_DH: recurrence engine (engine/code/recurrence.py v1.5, unchanged, read-only) on the same rescue3 tokens: --w 3 --null genome --perms 3 --fdr 0.01 (rule chosen by coverage at the FDR target), Louvain modules res 10 / J 0.5, --all-genome-loci; nested reading DH = level-2 conserved loci UNION rule-H cores (Louvain res 0.3 seed 17 module segmentation, trim_ends f 0.5), built with boundary/code blib.Landscape + rules.Builder.build('D', core H) (read-only imports). The engine counts lineages as GTDB genera from the package genomes.parquet genus column (GTDB r232 taxonomy); stated with every engine number
comparators.synton: Herve, Cury & Bernheim 2026 synton pipeline (repository commit 84baf14), baseline_synton adapters copied (run_pipeline.sbatch, make_inputs.py, fam_cascade.sh, nb2sh.py, synton_loci.py) with paths changed: faithful (linclust cascade 99/95/80/50% families) and matched (our rescue3 tokens), 24 CPUs each; run only if each finishes within the compute limit (expected 30-70 min each); a run beyond ~2 h is cancelled and reported as not run

scoring.all_genomes: every genome scored; headline numbers on all genomes; the even half (split.parquet even genome_code, 516 genomes) reported beside them for parity with DPANN
scoring.loci: each output is a set of inclusive gid intervals with e > s (single-gene loci absent), as Ctx.table on DPANN
scoring.ribosomal: gold/ribosomal_runs.parquet g2 runs with >= 16 marked genes (858). Standing definition (ribosomal_check.score): best = locus with the largest overlap (ties: shorter); recovered best_frac >= 0.5; resolved best_frac >= 0.8 and precision >= 0.8. Beside it: 'any fitting locus counts' = some locus with overlap / run >= 0.8 and overlap / locus length >= 0.8. Paired differences of resolved counts: run bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 17
scoring.lut_loci: shadow package (universe symlinked; gold/instances.parquet = lut_homology_main instances with caller 'lut_homology_main', system_type = architecture class, member_positions, resolved = all members on one contig, order_trusted = True, min_members 2) scored by ws_dpann/package/scorer/score_dpann_loci.py (read-only, as blib.score_table): per truth locus the best locus (max F1, then coverage, then shorter span); gene-level F1, coverage, precision (members inside / locus span); control = 200 rigid translations of the member pattern on its contig (seed sha256('17:' + instance_id)); excess = F1 - mean control F1. Means with 95% intervals from 10,000 bootstrap draws over truth loci (seed 17); paired differences between outputs by the same paired bootstrap over loci. Reported overall, by architecture class (system_type), by genome layer, on all genomes and on the even half. The 121 strict instances are reported as a secondary row
scoring.complete_clusters: main instances whose member components include all of A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I (lanM optional; expected 80, the a1 layer). Held = some single locus covers >= 80% of the members (the locus of largest coverage, ties shorter span); reported: count held, median and distribution of that locus's precision (members inside / locus span). Transporter module = the instance's member genes with components A, B, C, E, F, G (slice_lut: 'lutA/B/E/F + often lutG, lutC'); matched when some locus covers >= 80% of the module genes with module precision (module genes inside / locus span) >= 0.8; reported: matched by any locus, and matched by a locus nested inside (contained in) the holding locus
scoring.false_positive_side: relatives without any lut locus = layers b1 and b2. Lut homologs = genes with a reverse-best-hit assignment (05_loci.py RB tier: best AM1 hit is the component and forward E <= 1e-5) to one of the 10 cluster components, from slice_lut part-1 component_genes.parquet of the genome's source scope, mapped to package gids by protein_id. Isolated = no other RB component gene within 3 genes on the same contig. Reported per output: share of isolated homologs inside any locus, inside a locus of >= 3 genes, median span of the smallest containing locus; the same shares for all b1/b2 genes (background); loci in b1/b2 holding RB homologs of >= 2 distinct components (count) and >= 3 distinct components (count; a lut-like call in a lut-negative genome)
scoring.coverage: share of all genes in loci (and by layer); loci count; span quantiles
scoring.costs: wall time and peak memory per stage (/usr/bin/time -v per step)

Transporter module matched: primary 25-60, secondary 30-65, L1 0-10, DH 15-50; nested inside the holding locus for most matches of the tree outputs

expectations.costs: tokens 60-110 min on 64 CPUs (rescue prefilter dominates); GPU table 20-35 min, GPU kNN 15-30 min; prep 5-10 min / 100-140 GiB; Z arm 5-10 min / 30-110 GiB; WA build 5-15 min / < 10 GiB; engine + DH < 10 min; synton 30-70 min per run on 24 CPUs

failure_criteria.per_configuration: A configuration FAILS on this set if any of: (F1) ribosomal resolved < 644 of 858 (75%) or recovered < 816 (95%); (F2) lut main excess 95% lower bound < +0.15 or mean F1 < 0.60; (F3) against engine DH on the same tokens: lut excess difference < -0.02 with the 95% upper bound < 0, or ribosomal resolved difference with the 95% upper bound < 0; (F4) complete clusters held by one locus at >= 80% coverage in < 40 of 80. Criteria are evaluated on all genomes; the even half is reported beside them.
failure_criteria.comparison_wording: versus a comparator on paired excess d: BEATS if the 95% lower bound > 0; MATCHES if not beats and d >= -0.02; BELOW if d < -0.02 (interval always reported)

compute_plan: J1 tokens (64 CPUs; a guard stops the job after the rescue queries are known if the projected prefilter would take the job past ~110 min, and the estimate is reported instead); J2 GPU table + sums (A5000, queued); J3 GPU kNN (A5000); J4 groups, float32 vectors, token cohesion, WA build, engine, DH (64 CPUs); J5 prep + Z arm (64 CPUs); J6 / J7 synton faithful / matched (24 CPUs each); J8 scoring. At most 2 jobs of mine at a time; account below 400 CPUs; Slurm preflight before every submission.
